scope: 독립 공간 데이터와 읽기 전용 질의. 전투/이동/피해/등장순서/정산/저장 구현은 담당 호스트 소유.

coordinates.unit: LU (시제품 공간 비교 단위, 최종 미터/엔진 단위 미확정)
coordinates.screenPlaneBridge: toScreenPlane/fromScreenPlane return x/y only for presentation. Both simulation hosts use x/z.

visual.bounds: GLB visible bounds are measured; longestLU is an explicit uniform layout normalization, not source meters.
visual.collision: No implicit collider is generated from visible geometry.

collider.contact: touching counts as contact; clearance should add an explicit margin
collider.cameraPolicy: Fade visuals only. Do not remove physical solids or change hit logic.

spawnAnchor.rules: Spatial anchors carry no order/timing/enemy balance. Re-query against occupied bodies immediately before spawning.

trigger.rules: Overlap only advertises availability. No automatic settlement, cargo ownership change, repair, fabrication or save.

implementationLimits: AABB slab queries only; no physics solver, navmesh, damage, combat loop or engine adoption.
Body half-extents are supplied by the host; rotated body clearance should use conservative XZ radius or an OBB implementation.
Pixel readability, live load timing and rendered occlusion require integrated browser verification.
